title: Fix test failures after ObjectTable → ObjectGrid rename
body:
CI failing on PR #185 due to stale test references after component rename.

## Changes

- **ObjectGrid.test.tsx**: Update loading state assertion from `/Loading users/i` to `/Loading grid/i`
- **ObjectView.test.tsx**: Update mock import from `../ObjectTable` to `../ObjectGrid`

Both changes align tests with current component implementation (ObjectGrid.tsx line 282 and ObjectView.tsx line 18 respectively).
